correctness.rationale: The original inequality representation is equivalent to y in [0,1]^n+(m-sum x_i)Delta_n by splitting excess above one. Convex combinations of lower cube vertices and upper simplex/cube vertices produce an exact finite generating set. Comparing squared distances of pairs from it, distinct upper peak indices alone can reach 2(m+1)^2+n-2, with equality forcing zero lower blocks, full peaks at different indices and opposite background bits. Strict convexity excludes nonvertex diametral endpoints. This covers m=1,n=2 and zero slack. Independent exact enumerations checked 9 small (m,n) configurations.
